message.content: Hailey Johnson offers various services to Li Hua including delivering fresh bread and milk twice a week, specifically on Mondays at 8 AM and Fridays at 8 AM. Additionally, she provides personalized requests and suggestions for Li Hua to try, aiming to cater to her tastes and preferences. Through these offerings, Hailey demonstrates a commitment to ensuring Li Hua receives high-quality products and excellent customer service.
